description.sub_name: 電腦輔助計算手術科技應用
description.sub_ename: APPLIED TECHNOLOGY IN COMPUTER ASSISTED SURGERY
description.describe_ch: 醫療手術技術隨著醫院設備的進步與現代科技的創新發展，不論是傳統的開放性外科手術或是微創手術，對於電腦輔助資訊的需求愈來愈多，電腦輔助計算手術包括手術教學、手術模擬、手術最佳化、手術即時影像、手術機器人等領域。本課程將從現行醫療中常見的電腦輔助計算技術為出發點，介紹電機資訊機械科技在醫療上的應用，接著探討全球在電腦輔助計算手術上最新的研究發展與技術開發方向。此外配合臨床需求與實際案例討論，讓學生了解工程在醫學上的發展，並實際分析全球領先技術之研究內容做為學習的指標。
description.describe_eh: With the advancement of hospital equipment and the innovation and development of modern technology, medical surgery technology, whether it is traditional open surgery or minimally invasive surgery, there is an increasing demand for computer-assisted information. Computer-aided computing surgery includes surgery teaching and surgery. Simulation, surgical optimization, real-time surgical imaging, surgical robots and other fields. This course will start from the common computer-aided computing technology in current medical treatment, introduce the application of electrical machinery information technology in medical treatment, and then discuss the latest research development and technology development direction in computer-aided computing surgery in the world. In addition, in accordance with clinical needs and actual case discussions, students can understand the development of engineering in medicine, and actually analyze the research content of the world's leading technologies as learning indicators
